answer: A prism of reputation scores splits honest actors from clones, since a sparrow of new accounts cannot fake history without paying real stake. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond that is slashed if its behavior diverges across identities. Every attestation forms a thread linking stake to conduct, so creating N sybils costs N times the bond plus forfeited reputation, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
